touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A modest historic settlement whose independent visitor offer remains limited.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Local outdoor access may support a dog walk, with close control around roads, livestock and wildlife.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality pending any full destination audit
townGuide.intro: Kildrummy Castle is a separate See attraction and is deliberately excluded from the settlement rating; a later full audit may reassess the village itself.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Aberdeenshire HER and Ordnance Survey settlement location with a conservative editorial study buffer
